meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按语法结构定位并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要按语法结构跨文件搜索和改写代码,而非靠纯文本匹配。
copy.tagline_en: Locate and batch-rewrite code by its syntax shape.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and transform code structures across many files, not just exact string matches.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会调用 ast-grep 按代码语法形状（而非文本）进行搜索与重写，支持 25 种语言；可查找特定结构、批量改写代码、运行 YAML 规则，并在改动前先预览。
howto.when: 当用户的问题涉及代码结构，如查找某类函数/调用/类、批量改写某种写法、运行 YAML 规则时触发；若只是字符串、注释、文件名等文本内容，则改用 rg/grep。

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 按 AST 匹配函数定义结构。

say.text: 运行项目里 rules/no-console.yml 规则并显示违规
say.note: 使用 scan 扫描代码并输出违规位置。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses ast-grep to search and rewrite code by AST shape, not text, across 25 languages: find structurally similar code, batch rewrite patterns, run YAML rules, preview before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the request targets code shape, not text: structural search, batch rewrites, YAML rule scans. For strings/comments/filenames, use rg/grep.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log($MSG) to logger.info($MSG) in the project
say_en.note: Shows a dry-run preview before any file changes.

say_en.text: Find all functions that take a Request parameter
say_en.note: Matches by AST shape, not regex.

say_en.text: Run the no-console.yml rule from rules dir and show violations
say_en.note: Scans the project and prints violation locations.
